title: Unit tests — workflowService + workflowSlice
description: Write unit tests for workflowService.ts (CRUD operations, execution orchestration) and workflowSlice.ts (state management, async actions). Use vi.hoisted() + vi.mock for Tauri FS mocking.
action: Create src/services/__tests__/workflowService.test.ts and src/stores/app/__tests__/workflowSlice.test.ts with comprehensive unit tests covering CRUD, execution flow, checkpoint gates, and slice state transitions.

criteria: Service tests cover: loadWorkflows returns builtin + user workflows, saveWorkflow writes JSON, deleteWorkflow removes file, executeWorkflow chains steps, checkpoint pauses execution
Slice tests cover: fetchWorkflows populates state, startExecution sets activeExecution, approveStep advances step, rejectStep clears execution
All tests use vi.hoisted() + vi.mock('@tauri-apps/plugin-fs') pattern
npx vitest run --reporter=verbose passes all tests
convergence.definition_of_done: All service and slice unit tests pass with proper Tauri FS mocking

files.change: New test file covering workflow CRUD and execution orchestration
New test file covering slice state management and async actions

implementation: Mock '@tauri-apps/plugin-fs' using vi.hoisted() + vi.mock() pattern from templateService.test.ts
Mock src/api/agents.ts and src/api/intelligence.ts for execution tests
Test: loadWorkflows returns builtinWorkflows when no user files exist
Test: loadWorkflows merges user workflows with builtin templates
Test: saveWorkflow writes JSON to filesystem
Test: saveWorkflow rejects builtin- prefixed IDs
Test: deleteWorkflow removes file and rejects builtin- IDs
Test: executeWorkflow creates execution and runs first step
Test: executeNextStep pauses at checkpoint gate
Test: fetchWorkflows populates workflows array and clears loading
Test: saveWorkflow calls service then refreshes list
Test: startExecution sets activeExecution in state
Test: approveStep updates activeExecution with next step result
Test: error handling sets error state on service failure

success_metrics: ≥10 total test cases across both files

reference.pattern: Follow templateService.test.ts for Tauri FS mock pattern (vi.hoisted + vi.mock). Follow intelligenceSlice.test.ts for slice testing pattern.

rationale.chosen_approach: Phase 1 established the Tauri FS mock pattern with vi.hoisted() — reuse exactly for consistency
decision_factors: Same mock pattern proven in Phase 1
Co-located test files follow project convention
